english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the force or movement of water.

exampleSentences.english: The stream here is very strong, so be careful if you go into the water.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢段水流好急，落水要小心。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 seoi2 lau4 hou2 gap1 lok6 seoi2 jiu3 siu2 sam1

english.note: 水流 is a current of water; for a flow of air use 氣流 instead.

exampleSentences.english: The current here is very strong.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 dou6 ge3 seoi2 lau4 hou2 gap1
